weather.summary: Updated Aug 18: Sunday rain chance jumped to 88% (up from 59%) with thunderstorms and ~0.40 in of rain. Saturday 56% (~0.09 in), Friday travel day 58% (~0.14 in). Both game days need rain gear. Extreme heat through the week — Saturday RealFeel 107F, Sunday 102F, Friday travel 108F. Trend: Aug 10 (4%/6%), Aug 15 (55%/3%), Aug 16 (56%/59%), Aug 18 (56%/88%). Recheck morning of each game.
weather.details: Precipitation (AccuWeather 32223): Fri Aug 21 (travel) — 0.14 in expected, 58% chance, ~1 hr rain, humid with an afternoon thunderstorm, High 94F/Low 76F, RealFeel 108F, UV 7, SSW 8 mph. Sat Aug 22 — 0.09 in expected, 56% chance, ~1 hr rain, humid with clouds and a thunderstorm in the afternoon, High 95F/Low 77F, RealFeel 107F, UV 9, SW 9 mph. Sun Aug 23 — 0.40 in expected, 88% chance (up from 59%), ~3 hrs rain, mostly cloudy with a couple of thunderstorms, High 93F/Low 76F, RealFeel 102F, UV 4, SW 9 mph. Sources: AccuWeather 32223 + NWS Jacksonville (extreme heat warning active). Rain gear essential both game days; expect possible delays.

keyRules.label: Format
keyRules.value: 7v7 · Max roster 12 · Min 5 to start · Size 4 ball

keyRules.label: Mercy Rule
keyRules.value: 6-goal lead at halftime or later → match ends

keyRules.label: Goal Cap
keyRules.value: Max 4 goals per game for GD and GF tiebreakers

keyRules.label: Substitutions
keyRules.value: Unlimited at goal kicks, throw-ins, kickoffs, halftime, injury

keyRules.label: Heading
keyRules.value: Not allowed U12 and younger → indirect free kick

keyRules.label: Forfeit
keyRules.value: 5 min late (10 min finals). Min 5 players. Recorded as 4-0 loss.

keyRules.label: Zero Tolerance
keyRules.value: No ref abuse — immediate removal + suspension

keyRules.label: Weather
keyRules.value: 30-min delay clock. Post-halftime stoppage = completed game.

keyRules.label: Championship
keyRules.value: No OT — straight to PKs if tied

keyRules.label: Stay-to-Play

updates.title: Stay-to-play booking deadline has passed
updates.description: The Sporting Jax stay-to-play portal now shows the reservation deadline has passed — new bookings are request-only. Cancellations within 7 days of check-in incur a $25 fee; within 72 hours, one night's room rate. The portal's available hotel inventory and rates have also changed since our last update, so review the portal directly for current options before booking. Existing reservations are unaffected.

updates.description: Two practices scheduled after the Sporting Jax tournament: Mon Aug 24 and Wed Aug 26, both 5:30–7:00 PM at Jennifer Ross Soccer Complex Field 7. Regular season training resumes immediately after the tournament weekend.

Game 2 (Sat 3:30 PM, Field 6 vs JAX NFPL) — HOME, wear WHITE. Game 3 (Sun 10:30 AM, Field 5 vs JFC NFPL) — HOME, wear WHITE. Potential final (Sun 2:15 PM, Field 5) — TBD. Still pack both kits in case of late changes.

updates.title: Travel team not in Sporting Jax — only Premier plays
updates.description: PlayMetrics canceled the Sporting Jax tournament events (Sat Aug 22 & Sun Aug 23) for the 17/18B Travel team. Only the 17/18B Premier team is participating in this tournament. If you follow both teams in PlayMetrics, the Travel team's canceled events are expected — not an error.

venueRules.tents: Pop-up canopies allowed. Must be weighted (no stakes in turf fields). Place behind spectator line — not between field and sideline.
venueRules.pets: Rogers Park (Chuck Rogers Park) is pet-friendly. Dogs must be leashed. Clean up after your pet. Not all tournament venues allow pets — check each venue.
venueRules.foodCooler: Outside food and coolers allowed. No glass containers. Concessions available on-site.
venueRules.chairs: Folding chairs allowed along sidelines behind spectator line. Do not block access paths or medical lanes.
venueRules.smoking: Smoking only in designated areas away from fields and playgrounds.
